capabilities: Share vault folders with LAN teammates via one-time invite links
Enforce per-path access rules for users, teams, and devices
Sync room files in real time with conflict copies on concurrent edits
Co-edit Markdown notes with CRDT merging and live cursors
Review an activity log of server access
extras: README states the plugin is not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. All traffic stays on the LAN except one anonymous version check against the GitHub Releases API. CRDT live editing is the newest part and the README recommends keeping backups during its soak period.
problem: Real-time vault sharing normally requires a cloud service; Obsidian has no built-in way to share folders with people on the same local network without one.

relations.evidence: A room can recommend companion plugins (Kanban, Tasks); the room's Manage surface shows whether they're enabled locally.
A room can recommend companion plugins (Kanban, Tasks); the room's Manage surface shows whether they're enabled locally.

summary: LAN folder-sharing plugin that syncs selected vault folders between teammates in real time, with invite links, per-path permissions, and character-level Markdown co-editing.
